headline: [Deadly Blaze!] Fire Kills [11 People] on Thailand's Phuket Island
caption:
🔥 Deadly Blaze! Fire Kills 11 People on Thailand's Phuket Island

A fire killed at least 11 people early on Monday, November 16, in Patong, the main tourist area of Phuket island in southern Thailand, police said. It started in a building with a motorcycle rental shop on the ground floor and homes on the upper floors, and spread to nearby buildings.

🔹 At least 16 people were injured, treated for smoke and broken glass injuries. Authorities said no tourists were among the dead or injured.
🔹 Police said early checks show an electrical transformer near the building exploded shortly before the fire began. They ruled out arson, and the cause is still being investigated.
🔹 Phuket's governor said about 100 motorcycles, plus gas, engine oil, plastic and tyres stored in the shop, may have helped the fire spread fast and create thick, toxic smoke.

💬 Should fire safety checks be stricter in busy tourist areas? 👇
